_about: Page-harvest stage config (pipeline/harvest.py), per store. Presence in 'stores' enables the stage for that store; it OCRs the item's flyer cell (OCR stores: page crop at the item bbox; Flipp-shaped items: the item's own wishabi region image) to fill package_size / price_unit values that exist only in the flyer image. Evidence per store: docs/research/page-harvest.md (2026-10-16). 'fields' defaults to both.
